products.title: Upper Lower Chains Links that Solve Problems Faster by Josh Saunders
products.body:
Unlock the secret to faster problem-solving and fluid movement on the mats with Upper Lower Chains Links that Solve Problems Faster, an innovative BJJ instructional by Josh Saunders — a 2x ADCC Trials winner and ADCC semifinalist.

  • Josh Saunders has quickly risen to the top of BJJ instruction by focusing not just on techniques, but the underlying concepts that connect them
  • This groundbreaking approach empowers practitioners to adapt, innovate, and respond to challenges in real-time, making your game more dynamic and intuitive.
  • In this instructional, Josh breaks down the critical upper and lower body chains — the interconnected movement patterns that form the foundation of efficient grappling.


Check Out a Free Sample:

What will You Learn?

Unlock the secret to faster problem-solving and fluid movement on the mats with Upper Lower Chains Links that Solve Problems Faster, an innovative BJJ instructional by Josh Saunders — a 2x ADCC Trials winner and ADCC semifinalist.

Josh Saunders has quickly risen to the top of BJJ instruction by focusing not just on techniques, but the underlying concepts that connect them. This groundbreaking approach empowers practitioners to adapt, innovate, and respond to challenges in real-time, making your game more dynamic and intuitive.

In this instructional, Josh breaks down the critical upper and lower body chains — the interconnected movement patterns that form the foundation of efficient grappling. By mastering these chains, you’ll solve positional problems faster and transition smoothly between attacks, escapes, and controls.

Whether you're a competitor looking to sharpen your strategic edge or a hobbyist wanting to deepen your understanding, this conceptual guide will transform how you think about and practice Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

Bullet Points

  • Concept-Driven Learning: Go beyond isolated techniques and grasp the fundamental movement chains that make your game cohesive and adaptable.

  • Upper & Lower Body Focus: Discover how interconnected chains in both upper and lower body movement solve common positional problems faster.

  • Learn From a Proven Competitor: Instruction from Josh Saunders, a 2x ADCC Trials winner and ADCC semifinalist with elite competition experience.

  • Enhanced Problem-Solving: Develop the ability to intuitively react and transition smoothly between positions with fewer mental blocks.

  • Ideal for All Levels: Whether competitor or hobbyist, deepen your understanding of BJJ concepts to improve fluidity and control.

  • Best-Selling Approach: Join thousands who have benefited from Josh’s unique teaching style that emphasizes concepts over rote memorization.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1

  • Intro
  • Standing Attacks - Feinting for a Leg to Improve Snap Down
  • Reach for Single Leg to Open Underhook
  • Underhook to High Crotch
  • Climb to a Body Lock off Failed Double Leg
  • Far Side Swing Single to Defend Underhook
  • Arm Drag to Single
  • Te Guruma


Part 2

  • Ground Attacks From Top - Dorsal Kimura to Inside Sankaku
  • ¼ Guard to Inside Sankaku
  • Pinning by Walking to Half Guard and Covering the Hips
  • Defending Octopus Guard by Stepping Over
  • Opponent Uses Arm Bar Defense that Traps the Leg - Inside Sankaku
  • Attacking Turtle - Go Behinds or Arm In Guillotines


Part 3

  • Ground Attacks from Bottom - Double Kouchi to Force Sprawl to Access the Upper Body
  • Half Butterfly - Attacking Legs to Open Choi Bar
  • Half Butterfly - Attacking Choi Bar to Open Up the Legs
  • Half Butterfly - Arm Drag into the Legs/Wrestle Up
  • Closed Guard - Scoop into K Guard to Hantai Sankaku
  • Inside Sankaku Turn into Back Take
  • Wrestle Up from Reverse De La Riva


Part 4

  • Escapes - Half Guard - Knee Levers to Open Underhook to Lower Leg Shift
  • Half Guard - Use Butterfly Hooks to Escape Cross Face Underhook
  • Side Control - Hips vs Upper Body
  • Side Control - Underhook vs Weave Grip and Going Behind Leg
  • Outro

products.title: Wrong Way First by Josh Saunders
products.body:
Wrong Way First by Josh Saunders

  • A unique and unconventional approach to BJJ that combines escapes, submissions, wrestling, judo, guard, and passing
  • Josh Saunders teaches you how to use misdirection and unexpected angles to catch your opponents off guard
  • Covers 6 volumes spanning escapes, submissions and attacks, wrestling, judo, guard play, and passing
  • Learn creative combinations that chain together techniques from different positions


What Will You Learn?

Josh Saunders presents a unique system built around doing things the "wrong way" — using unconventional entries, misdirection, and unexpected angles to create openings your opponents won't see coming. This 6-volume set covers every major area of grappling, from escapes and submissions to wrestling, judo, guard play, and passing, giving you a complete toolkit of creative, high-percentage techniques.

Technique List

Volume 1: Escapes

  • Introduction
  • Kipping vs. Bridging
  • Marcelo vs. Knee Elbow
  • Side Kipping vs. Knee Elbow
  • John Wayne Into Lower Leg Shift
  • Chest Lock - Drag Out

Volume 2: Submissions and Attacks

  • Turtle Attack Into Tamagotchi
  • Anaconda Into Darce
  • Double Trouble Into Diagonal
  • Misdirectional Go Behind
  • Kata Gatame Into Roll Through Reverse Darce

Volume 3: Wrestling

  • Swing vs. Duck
  • Russian Defense Push the Head Then Duck
  • Sidakov Underhook and Slide-By
  • Snap Into Shots
  • Near Pick Into Far Pick or Vice-Versa

Volume 4: Judo

  • Uchi vs. Ouchi-Kouchi
  • Uchi vs. Harai
  • Step Behind vs. Uki Goshi O Goshi

Volume 5: Guard

  • Knee Lever to Inversion
  • R-Guard to High R-Guard
  • Collar Tie Sumi Gaeshi One Way to the Other
  • Near Drag to Choi Bar
  • Shin Guard Into Opposite Leg - Back Sweep to Reap

Volume 6: Passing

  • DLR Knee Cut to Smash
  • Toreando Passing
  • Split Squat to Far Knee Cut
  • Underhook Knee Cut
  • Split Squat to Butterfly Half Passing
  • Outro
